supplier_name: OpenAI API and official Node SDK
service_role: Optional assistant model/API provider; governed-provider target implementation
data_classes_or_access: Conversation history/request content when enabled; generated response; model/response/usage metadata
auth_category: Secret API key in protected runtime/GitHub Actions secret; never repository plaintext
fallback_or_exit: Provider can remain disabled; no alternate model provider is currently evidenced as integrated
reassessment_trigger: Provider terms/data-use change; model/rate-card change; production enablement; new data class; incident

service_role: Current live database platform and future target for repository migrations
data_classes_or_access: Application and project records; conversation/document/memory-related schema; module metadata; future Foundry/FinOps provenance if deployed
auth_category: PostgreSQL connection credentials / service credentials managed outside repository
fallback_or_exit: Portable PostgreSQL architecture provides a conceptual exit path, but tested export/restore/provider migration evidence is not established in GOV-003
reassessment_trigger: Security posture or Data API change; migration/deployment; region/terms/subprocessor change; outage/incident; exit test

service_role: Authoritative source control, pull requests, issues, Actions CI and Codespaces/devcontainer development platform
dependency_scope: Development/verification evidence for all repository systems
data_classes_or_access: Source code; issues/PRs; workflow logs/artifacts; repository metadata; protected Actions secrets
auth_category: GitHub account/App authorization and Actions secrets
fallback_or_exit: Repository is git-portable but CI/project history/Codespaces replacement has not been tested as an exit plan
reassessment_trigger: Material workflow/platform/terms change; CI incident; secret exposure; repository visibility/ownership change; continuity test

supplier_name: npm package registry and JavaScript package ecosystem
service_role: Development/build supply chain for server dependencies including pinned OpenAI SDK
data_classes_or_access: Package/version metadata and dependency downloads; no CoMind customer/runtime content is intended to be transmitted by package installation itself
auth_category: Public/package-registry access; any registry credentials must remain outside repository
fallback_or_exit: Lockfile pins resolved dependency graph; offline/cache/alternate-registry recovery is not established
reassessment_trigger: Dependency update; advisory; package ownership/integrity event; registry outage; lockfile change
